symptom: A new visual direction (12px floating surfaces, solid tooltips, neutral reference pills, one badge size) needed every caller found by hand: callers reshaped Badge heights, pinned a blue workspace chip and recreated menu rows, and tests pinned the old look at call sites.
rule: A direction lands once at its owner (token, primitive or shared pattern) with a test there, callers compose without restyling, and the superseded variant retires (docs/design-system.md §0, 'How the direction changes'; playbooks/ui-design.md step 8).
